title: Deflection Field
text: Starlight flickers across a translucent pink hexagonal shield. Holding it grants a 25% chance to evade attacks. Incoming projectiles are randomly deflected while lowered, or reflected back along their incoming path while raised. Raising it also grants 25% damage reduction. Spatial Blades are not ordinary projectiles and cannot be reflected.

Durability: 256. Each deflection or reflection costs 1 durability; holding the shield raised costs an additional 1 per second. Unbreaking applies to both costs. While held, it repairs itself using mana, like infused tools: 5 mana restores 1 durability.
